title: Discover installed capabilities and operations
summary: List every installed capability and operation with enough meaning for an agent to select plausible contracts, then read their full operating boundaries.
use_when: A request may map to an installed local capability or adaptive operation.
The exact supported outcome, effects, authority, recovery, privacy, or invocation must be understood without inspecting source code.
do_not_use_when: The correct capability is already known and its current contract has already been read in this session.
The task is ordinary work with no plausible installed-system catalog need.
outcome: The caller receives a complete semantic catalog or one complete installed contract; no represented action is performed.
effects: Reads explicitly indexed JSON and Markdown from installed provider bundles.
Writes no provider state and performs no readiness probe.
authority: Provider bundles are authoritative for documented support and semantics.
Chancery is authoritative only for structural validation, installed catalog discovery, and presentation.
The represented product remains authoritative for runtime readiness and domain success.
success: List reports every structurally valid installed entry, including deprecated or dependency-unavailable entries, with visible registry issues.
Show returns the complete version-matched contract and manual for an installed entry.
No documented invocation is executed as a side effect of discovery.
failure_and_recovery: A malformed provider is excluded and reported without hiding structurally valid providers.
A missing or incompatible dependency makes the affected entry unavailable until the owning provider is installed or updated.
Use doctor to inspect registry structure; use the provider's own operating contract for live readiness.
privacy: Installed documentation is processed locally and is not retained by Chancery.
Chancery has no network or model integration.
